content: One approach to learn such schemes is to collect a supervised dataset of keywords-sentence pairs as a training set, but (i) it would be expensive to collect such data from users, and (ii) a static dataset would not capture a real user's natural predilection to adapt to the system BIBREF2. Another approach is to avoid supervision and jointly learn a user-system communication scheme to directly optimize the combination of efficiency and accuracy. However, learning in this way can lead to communication schemes that are uninterpretable to humans BIBREF3, BIBREF4 (see Appendix for additional related work).
